title: Home Comfort Financing Credit Tier and Amount Matrix
content:
Credit desk matrix for Home Comfort Financing: for each plan, the amounts the plan finances, the credit tiers that may be approved for it, and the down payment a Tier 3 or Tier 4 approval requires, as a percent of the project amount.

| Plan | Smallest amount financed | Largest amount financed | Credit tiers that may be approved | Tier 3 down payment | Tier 4 down payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan | $1500.00 | $25000.00 | Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 | 10% | 0% |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | $2500.00 | $30000.00 | Tier 1, Tier 2 | 0% | 0% |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | $5000.00 | $35000.00 | Tier 1 | 0% | 0% |
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | $3000.00 | $50000.00 | Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 | 5% | 0% |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | $5000.00 | $65000.00 | Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, Tier 4 | 5% | 10% |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | $7500.00 | $65000.00 | Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, Tier 4 | 5% | 10% |

## Reading the matrix by credit tier

| Credit tier | Plans whose eligible tiers include it |
|---|---|
| Tier 1 | all six plans |
| Tier 2 | 12-Month Same-As-Cash, 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment, 60-Month 5.99%, 120-Month 7.99%, 144-Month 9.99% |
| Tier 3 | 12-Month Same-As-Cash, 60-Month 5.99%, 120-Month 7.99%, 144-Month 9.99% |
| Tier 4 | 120-Month 7.99%, 144-Month 9.99% |

A down-payment percentage of 0% for a tier on a plan whose eligible tiers do not include that tier carries no meaning, since that tier is not approved for the plan. The two percentages that apply in practice are: Tier 3 at 10% on the 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan and 5% on the three fixed-rate plans; Tier 4 at 10% on the 120-Month and 144-Month fixed-rate plans.
